about_the_game:
Sci-Fi casual adventure single-player third-person shooter with fluid movement and little military strategy, this shooter will not give you nightmares or anxiety, inspired in funny games. Created with UE4 and optimized to work on low-tier modern and old PCs and laptops.

Story

An Asteroid hit the planet earth in 2029, millions have died, and people is hopeless because they know THE FALSE PROPHET and the BEAST with the help of the EREV RAV and AMALEK which by dark practices they can use corpses to open portals in Heaven and Hell, in which demons can access those high places, and maybe this is the reason why some hellish portals are being opened in Earth through which demons and beings from Hell arrive to this world.

During those perilous times an space ship enterprise names SPACE IXI created an space army to fight those demons (The government said that those are aliens, not demons) to erase those dark creatures from earth and other planets..

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win10 64bits
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8250U CPU @ 1.60GHz 1.80 GHz
  • Memory: 2080 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) UHD Graphic 620
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2090 MB available space

short_description: Sci-Fi casual adventure single-player third-person shooter with fluid movement and little military strategy. Spaceship private company SPACE IXI collects corpses that the EREV RAV had hidden in order to use them to create hellish portals in heaven and earth.
